params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Kennen}} {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Mark of the Storm'' to enemies hit.
params.blurb2: The third stack consumes them all to briefly {{tip|stun}} the target and restore {{as|{{sti|energy}}}}. The duration is dramatically reduced if this occurs on the same target again within a few seconds.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Kennen's''' {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Mark of the Storm'' to enemies hit for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times.
params.description2: The third stack against a target consumes them all to {{tip|stun}} them for {{fd|1.25}} seconds and restore {{sti|{{as|25 energy}}}}. The stun duration is reduced to {{fd|0.5}} seconds if this occurs on the same target again within 6 seconds.
params.description3: ''{{ai|Slicing Maelstrom|Kennen}} can apply only up to 3 stacks on a target.''
params.notes:
* '''Kennen''' will still restore energy if the target dies from the third stack of ''Mark of the Storm''.
* After {{ai|Slicing Maelstrom|Kennen}} applies its third stack, the target gains a 6-second stack immunity against ''Slicing Maelstrom'' that refreshes on subsequent hits.

blurb.plain: Innate: Kennen abilities apply a stack of Mark of the Storm to enemies hit.

blurb2.plain: The third stack consumes them all to briefly stun the target and restore energy. The duration is dramatically reduced if this occurs on the same target again within a few seconds.

description.plain: Innate: Kennen's abilities apply a stack of Mark of the Storm to enemies hit for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times.

description2.plain: The third stack against a target consumes them all to stun them for 1.25 seconds and restore 25 energy. The stun duration is reduced to 0.5 seconds if this occurs on the same target again within 6 seconds.

description3.plain: Slicing Maelstrom can apply only up to 3 stacks on a target.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{cis|Kennen}} basic attacks {{tip|on-attack}} generate a stack of ''Electrical Surge'', which stacks up to a cap. At max stacks, his next basic attack consumes them all to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and apply a stack of ''{{ai|Mark of the Storm|Kennen}}''.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kennen''' sends out a surge of electricity that deals {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies afflicted by ''{{ai|Mark of the Storm|Kennen}}'' or within ''{{ai|Slicing Maelstrom|Kennen}}''.
params.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} '''Kennen's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-attack}} generate a stack of ''Electrical Surge'', stacking up to 4 times. At 4 stacks, his next basic attack {{tip|on-attack}} consumes all stacks to both deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and apply a stack of ''{{ai|Mark of the Storm|Kennen}}'' {{tip|on-hit}}. This damage can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|140|40}}|critical damage}} damage.
'''Kennen''' gains maximum stacks of ''Electrical Surge'' upon [[death|respawning]].
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kennen''' sends out a surge of electricity that deals {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies afflicted by ''{{ai|Mark of the Storm|Kennen}}'' or within ''{{ai|Slicing Maelstrom|Kennen}}''.
params.leveling: {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|35 to 75}} {{as|(+ {{ap|80 to 120}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}}}}
params.description3: ''An enemy within {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 775 units with {{ai|Mark of the Storm|Kennen}} or inside {{ai|Slicing Maelstrom|Kennen}} is required to cast this ability. The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be targeted by this ability.''
params.effect radius: {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|775|Pending for test; targets acquired at cast start or end}}
params.notes:
* The empowered basic attack applies bonus {{tip|spell damage}}, while the electrical surge deals {{tip|area damage}}.
* ''Electrical Surge's'' enhanced attack will be consumed and the bonus damage will not be applied if '''Kennen''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.
** ''Electrical Surge's'' enhanced attack cannot be {{tip|dodge|dodged}} or {{tip|block|blocked}}.
* Uniquely to ''Electrical Surge'', {{tip|on-hit}} effects triggered by the enhanced attack's {{tip|cast instance}} (e.g. {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nie|Wind's Fury}}, {{iis|Dusk and Dawn}} {{nie|Spellblade}}) will apply the bonus damage and ''{{ai|Mark of the Storm|Kennen}}'' to targets hit.
** This is not the case with any other effects applied {{tip|on-hit}}.
** {{note|2}} This is intentional.
* The empowered attack will trigger but not be consumed nor apply its effects against {{tip|structures}} and {{tip|wards}}.

blurb.plain: Passive: Kennen basic attacks on-attack generate a stack of Electrical Surge, which stacks up to a cap. At max stacks, his next basic attack consumes them all to deal bonus magic damage and apply a stack of Mark of the Storm.

blurb2.plain: Active: Kennen sends out a surge of electricity that deals magic damage to all nearby enemies afflicted by Mark of the Storm or within Slicing Maelstrom.

description.plain: Passive: Kennen's basic attacks on-attack generate a stack of Electrical Surge, stacking up to 4 times. At 4 stacks, his next basic attack on-attack consumes all stacks to both deal bonus magic damage and apply a stack of Mark of the Storm on-hit. This damage can critically strike for ⟦critical damage⟧ damage. Kennen gains maximum stacks of Electrical Surge upon respawning.

description2.plain: Active: Kennen sends out a surge of electricity that deals magic damage to all nearby enemies afflicted by Mark of the Storm or within Slicing Maelstrom.

description3.plain: An enemy within cr 775 units with Mark of the Storm or inside Slicing Maelstrom is required to cast this ability. The target does not have to be visible to be targeted by this ability.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Kennen}} becomes lightning, a {{tip|ghosted}} form that gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for a short time. He deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies he passes through and restores {{sti|{{as|energy}}}} if he damaged an enemy at all. ''Lightning Rush'' can be recast within the duration and automatically recasts afterwards.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Kennen''' ends ''Lightning Rush'' to gain {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for a few seconds. {{Tip|Critical strikes}} extend the duration slightly.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kennen''' turns into lightning for 2 seconds, becoming unable to declare basic attacks but gaining {{tip|ghosting}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|100% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}. He deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies he passes through, reduced to 65% against non-champions, and restores {{sti|{{as|40 energy}}}} upon damaging at least one enemy.
params.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 240}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}|Non-Champion Damage|{{ap|80*0.65 to 240*0.65}} {{as|(+ {{ap|80*0.65}}% AP)}}}}
params.description2: ''Lightning Rush'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds, and does so automatically after the duration.
params.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Kennen''' ends ''Lightning Rush'' to gain {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and be allowed to exceed the {{tt|attack speed cap|normally 3.003 attacks per second}} by the amount gained for 4 seconds. {{tip|Critical strikes}} extend the {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed's}} duration by 1 second, up to the original duration.
params.description4: ''Lightning Rush's recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''
params.notes:
* ''Lightning Rush'' will only damage any particular enemy once per cast.
* For the purpose of aim-assist, '''Kennen's''' {{as|{{sti|attack range}}}} is reduced{{ft|by 575|to -25}}during ''Lightning Rush'', further reduced to -{{fd|33.75}} with {{ii|Rapid Firecannon}}.

blurb.plain: Active: Kennen becomes lightning, a ghosted form that gains bonus movement speed for a short time. He deals magic damage to enemies he passes through and restores energy if he damaged an enemy at all. Lightning Rush can be recast within the duration and automatically recasts afterwards.

blurb2.plain: Recast: Kennen ends Lightning Rush to gain bonus attack speed for a few seconds. Critical strikes extend the duration slightly.

description.plain: Active: Kennen turns into lightning for 2 seconds, becoming unable to declare basic attacks but gaining ghosting and 100% bonus movement speed. He deals magic damage to enemies he passes through, reduced to 65% against non-champions, and restores 40 energy upon damaging at least one enemy.

description2.plain: Lightning Rush can be recast after 0.5 seconds, and does so automatically after the duration.

description3.plain: Recast: Kennen ends Lightning Rush to gain bonus attack speed and be allowed to exceed the attack speed cap by the amount gained for 4 seconds. Critical strikes extend the bonus attack speed's duration by 1 second, up to the original duration.

description4.plain: Lightning Rush's recast can be used while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Kennen}} summons a storm that strikes at nearby enemy champions, dealing {{as|magic damage}}. Enemies take increased damage from each subsequent strike.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kennen''' summons a storm around himself for 3 seconds, gaining {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} for the duration.
params.description2: The storm strikes lightning bolts down on nearby enemies every {{fd|0.5}} seconds, each one dealing {{as|magic damage}}.
params.description3: ''Slicing Maelstrom'' gains 10% additional damage for each subsequent strike a target has received, up to a combined total of 150% of the initial strike's damage.
params.description4: '''''Kennen''' can move during Slicing Maelstrom's cast time.''

blurb.plain: Active: Kennen summons a storm that strikes at nearby enemy champions, dealing magic damage. Enemies take increased damage from each subsequent strike.

description.plain: Active: Kennen summons a storm around himself for 3 seconds, gaining bonus armor and bonus magic resistance for the duration.

description2.plain: The storm strikes lightning bolts down on nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds, each one dealing magic damage.

description3.plain: Slicing Maelstrom gains 10% additional damage for each subsequent strike a target has received, up to a combined total of 150% of the initial strike's damage.

description4.plain: Kennen can move during Slicing Maelstrom's cast time.
